notes: Cameras started independently — not synchronized at capture time. Audio cross-correlation required for sync.

pixel9.notes: 120fps source — extract at 2fps for SfM (≈854 frames)

samsung_a15.notes: Longest duration by ~61s vs Pixel9. Started earliest or stopped latest. Lowest resolution — may need upscale consideration for COLMAP feature matching.

gopro_max.format_notes: GoPro MAX .360 proprietary EAC dual-fisheye. Must convert to equirectangular before use. ffmpeg v360=eac:equirect available. Verify stitching quality before committing.

duration_overlap_notes: Pixel9=427s, GoPro=431s, A15=488s. A15 is 61s longer than Pixel9. Overlap region must be identified via audio sync before trimming.
